title: ₹100 Ki Dawai Pe Medical Store Owner Kitna Kamata Hai?
description: No scraped reels this week, so this is reasoning. Our best reel breaks down what the owner keeps per ₹100 at a business everyone has visited. A medical store is just as familiar, nobody knows the margin, and it is a classic 'safe business' dream. The margin tiers are published and the numbers are shareable.
text:
# HISAAB FACT SHEET: Retail chemist margins (branded vs generic vs Jan Aushadhi)
Compiled 3 Nov 2026. Figures come from the sources cited. Many are estimates from lender or franchise blogs, and they vary by city, brand and company.

## 1. The ₹100 strip: who gets what
- **Terms:** PTS is what the stockist pays the company. PTR is what the chemist pays the stockist. PTR is the rate at which a pharmacy buys from a distributor. PTS is the rate at which the distributor buys from the company. [https://www.healthpride.in/ptr-pts-calculator/]
- **Convention for medicines outside price control:** about 10% to the stockist on PTS, and about 20% to the retailer on PTR. [https://uncarriedinterest.substack.com/p/indian-pharma-distribution-roll-up]
- **Total trade share:** On a normal branded generic, the whole trade keeps about 24% of MRP, and the stockist's share is about 7%. The author says this is his own arithmetic on conventional markups. Actual terms vary by brand and company. [https://uncarriedinterest.substack.com/p/indian-pharma-distribution-roll-up]
- **Worked example A (12% GST):** MRP ₹100, 20% margin, 12% GST gives PTR ₹71.43. At a 10% stockist margin, PTS is ₹64.29. [https://mymbill.com/tools/ptr-pts-calculator]
- **Worked example B (5% GST):** MRP ₹100, 20% retailer margin and 5% GST gives PTR ₹76.19. [https://vibcare.co.in/ptr-pts-calculator]
- **Caution:** Calculators disagree on whether the margin is taken on MRP or on the price before GST. One says margins are applied directly on MRP [https://totalcalchub.com/in/utilities/ptr-pts-calculator]. Another says margins are calculated on the base price (MRP excluding GST) [https://calculatorhub.co.in/pts-ptr-calculator/].
- **Before shooting:** Pick one convention and check it against a real chemist's purchase invoice.

## 2. Branded medicines: the chemist's margin
- **Branded drugs outside price control:** Margins on branded medicines typically run at 16–22%. [https://www.shriramfinance.in/articles/business-loan/2026/how-to-start-pharmacy-business-in-india]
- **Another range:** Retailer margin is commonly 16–20% and stockist margin 8–10%, but it varies by company and product segment. [https://indiapharmafranchise.com/2025/04/19/ptr-and-pts-calculator-and-its-explanation/]
